compounds.//: Cleanup lives on each configuration, not here: VS Code ignores postDebugTask on a compound (the compound schema accepts only name, presentation, configurations, stopAll, preLaunchTask). stopAll is session-level and fires only on a *manual* stop.
compounds.name: Duct: App + API

compounds.//: Dev-variant bundle against a locally-run Railway-shaped API. Registered .app, so the sign-in deep link works.
compounds.name: Duct: Desktop + API

configurations.//: OTEL_ENDPOINT is what turns agent telemetry on (see agents/core/claude_sdk.py). Without it the Phoenix compound starts a trace UI that receives nothing.
configurations.name: Backend: FastAPI (uvicorn verbose)

configurations.//: Freezes the backend into backend/dist/duct-sidecar. Required before the desktop app can run: bundle.resources copies this directory verbatim, so a missing or stale build ships a broken app. Takes ~3 min.
configurations.name: Desktop: Build sidecar

configurations.//: Local-first desktop: the shell spawns the frozen sidecar on a loopback port and the web app repoints at it, so no uvicorn and no Railway. `dev:local` starts the Next dev server itself via beforeDevCommand. Run 'Desktop: Build sidecar' first — sidecar.rs falls back to backend/dist/duct-sidecar, so a stale build there is what you get.
configurations.name: Desktop: Tauri dev (sidecar backend)

configurations.//: Builds the dev-variant bundle (own identifier + ai.getduct.desktop.dev scheme, so it coexists with TestFlight), waits for the Next dev server, then opens it. Unlike `tauri dev` this is a registered .app, so the sign-in deep link works. Rebuild is incremental (~15s); web changes still hot-reload. NOTE: `open` hands the app to launchd and this session ends immediately, so Stop cannot close it and no postDebugTask can be attached here — quit the app yourself, or run the 'Desktop: stop Duct Dev app' task. Force-quitting skips RunEvent::Exit and orphans its Python sidecar.
configurations.name: Desktop: Duct Dev app (build + open)
configurations.command: npm run build:dev && until curl -sf http://localhost:3003 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && open 'src-tauri/target/debug/bundle/macos/Duct Dev.app'
